description: Send a signed message to an AI Cofounder chat. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

chatId.description: Chat ID, from a chat listing.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

intentType.description: Intent of the AI Cofounder message, as accepted by the AI Cofounder API.

message.description: Message text to send to AI Cofounder.

platform.description: Messaging channel; use one of the allowed values.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Singapore.

name: send_ai_cofounder_message
title: Send AI Cofounder Message
